6: 
7: # Use Case Management
8: 
9: ## Overview
10: 
11: To manage workspace use cases, use the REPL client passthrough for `client.UseCases.*` (or MCP tools `usecase_*` on the Streamable HTTP / STDIO transport when that surface is active). Do not substitute raw REST when the plugin wrapper/REPL path is available.
12: 
13: Server REST base path: `/mcpserver/usecases`. Typed client: `McpServerClient.UseCases`. Plugin-core MCP tools: `usecase_*` (for hosts that load the MCP Server plugin core).
14: 
15: Bootstrap session log before mutations:
16: 
17: ```yaml
18: type: request
19: payload:
20:   requestId: req-20260808T120000Z-bootstrap-001
21:   method: workflow.sessionlog.bootstrap
22:   params: {}
23: ```
24: 
25: ## List use cases
26: 
27: ```yaml
28: type: request
29: payload:
30:   requestId: req-20260808T120001Z-uc-list
31:   method: client.UseCases.ListAsync
32:   params:
33:     title: Login
34: ```
35: 
36: `title` is optional. Omit params to list all.
37: 
38: ## Get use case
39: 
40: ```yaml
41: type: request
42: payload:
43:   requestId: req-20260808T120002Z-uc-get
44:   method: client.UseCases.GetAsync
45:   params:
46:     useCaseId: 1
47: ```
48: 
49: Detail includes `versionNumber`, `approvalStatus`, `productKey`, actors, flows, steps, and `frLinks`.
50: 
51: ## Create use case
52: 
53: ```yaml
54: type: request
55: payload:
56:   requestId: req-20260808T120003Z-uc-create
57:   method: client.UseCases.CreateAsync
58:   params:
59:     request:
60:       title: Login
61:       briefDescription: User authenticates
62:       createBasicFlow: true
63:       frId: FR-MCP-001
64:       linkType: Realizes
65: ```
66: 
67: Required: `request.title`. Optional: `frId` (default link type Realizes), `createBasicFlow`.
68: 
69: ## Update / delete
70: 
71: ```yaml
72: method: client.UseCases.UpdateAsync
73: params:
74:   useCaseId: 1
75:   request:
76:     title: Login (updated)
77: ```
78: 
79: ```yaml
80: method: client.UseCases.DeleteAsync
81: params:
82:   useCaseId: 1
83: ```
84: 
85: ## Link / from FR
86: 
87: ```yaml
88: method: client.UseCases.LinkFrAsync
89: params:
90:   useCaseId: 1
91:   request:
92:     frId: FR-MCP-001
93:     linkType: Realizes
94: ```
95: 
96: ```yaml
97: method: client.UseCases.CreateFromFrAsync
98: params:
99:   frId: FR-MCP-001
100:   request:
101:     title: Optional title override
102: ```
103: 
104: ## Diagram
105: 
106: ```yaml
107: method: client.UseCases.GetDiagramAsync
108: params:
109:   useCaseId: 1
110:   format: mermaid
111: ```
112: 
113: Supported formats: `mermaid` (primary), `plantuml`.
114: 
115: ## Coverage (live DTO shape)
116: 
117: ```yaml
118: method: client.UseCases.GetCoverageAsync
119: params: {}
120: ```
121: 
122: Result properties (do not invent alternate names):
123: 
124: - `totalUseCases`, `totalFunctionalRequirements`
125: - `linkedUseCases`, `linkedFunctionalRequirements`
126: - `useCasesWithoutRealizesLink` (array of summaries)
127: - `functionalRequirementsWithoutRealizesUseCase` (array of FR id strings)
128: 
129: ## Approval and product hooks
130: 
131: ```yaml
132: method: client.UseCases.SetApprovalAsync
133: params:
134:   useCaseId: 1
135:   request:
136:     status: Approved
137: ```
138: 
139: Statuses: `Draft`, `Submitted`, `Approved`, `Rejected`. Approving increments `versionNumber`.
140: 
141: ```yaml
142: method: client.UseCases.SetProductAsync
143: params:
144:   useCaseId: 1
145:   request:
146:     productKey: prod-mcp-core
147: ```
148: 
149: ```yaml
150: method: client.UseCases.ListByProductAsync
151: params:
152:   productKey: prod-mcp-core
153: ```
154: 
155: ## MCP tool names (STDIO / Streamable HTTP)
156: 
157: When using MCP tools instead of REPL client passthrough: `usecase_list`, `usecase_get`, `usecase_create`, `usecase_update`, `usecase_delete`, `usecase_link_fr`, `usecase_from_fr`, `usecase_diagram`, `usecase_coverage`. Expanded plugin-core tools also include `usecase_set_approval`, `usecase_set_product`, `usecase_list_by_product`.
158: 
159: ## UI
160: 
161: First-party UI is served at `/usecases/` on the Support.Mcp host and calls REST only.
